The transgender label is meaningless - how is it possible for someone to distinguish a 'transgender' from someone merely pretending to be one? By the definitions available, you can't. This is how useless the word is and we all get lumped in with people - stigmatising, unwelcome associations - who don't share any of our experiences and have nothing to do with us. When you see all the freakishness on Tumblr its nothing but the consequence of the activists' so-called 'gender umbrella' rather than scientific specificity.

Even the transsexual label is confusing and outdated. Just a cursory look at the fuss over the autogymephilia controversy will reveal why mostly autogynephiles objected. Someone like (say) Deidre McCluskey or Caitlyn Jenner does not share our early life experiences or the variety of dysphoria we suffer, or they would not have been able to lead functionally male lives. Confusing them with us doesn't do us any favours. Even if the autogynephilia theory were untrue they still have nothing to do with us.

Even worse is the media's desire to blur us with people like Conchita Wurst who blur gender lines deliberately. Though this is the exact opposite of our feelings the media has presented them as the face of the transgendered. Remember that this is what families and others round us see when they are told we are transgendered, and it does not help us at all. Even at GICs and other supposedly medical institutions where we try to find help, our healthcare needs are downplayed whilst genderqueers are pandered to and potentially offensive LGBT symbolism is pushed in our faces.

We aren't transgender (whatever that is) and we don't have an identity around our disease. We just want purely medical help and understanding as people who were born with a disorder of sexual development. For this the transgenders name us as truscum or transmedicalists - and we have even been subject to harassment by identity transgenders. This is nothing political on our part and we have no part of any community, but we are seen as dissenters and the forced association with all kinds of 'gender nonconformists' has created confusion about the medical condition.

This is finally our safe space. Please respect it.
